description:
Cold audit against origin/main a3a9761d1209165e5230625b9347cf6b0ad09b83.

`World::function_declares_contract` (`src/compiler2/world.rs:1143-1153`) returns false for `FunctionState::Placeholder` and `FunctionState::Noted`, collapsing “definition unavailable” into “defined and declares no contract.” `require_function_contract` (`src/compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs:1674-1689`) consequently reports an undefined function contract-ready.

The original runtime claim is not supported by the current call graph. `call_emission_for_function` is called only by `rebuild_coalesced_call_emission` while rebuilding an existing `Resolved` target (`semantic.rs:1136-1180`). A `SelectedCallee::Function` target is created only after `resolve_function_call`'s definedness gate (`1307-1311`) or `resolve_protocol_call`'s corresponding gate (`1448-1453`). `FunctionMap::note` also deliberately preserves `Defined` rather than demoting it during source refresh (`identity.rs:576-584`). Therefore a not-yet-defined callee is not presently shown to “silently resolve contract-free” through `call_emission_for_function`, and a generic late-module fixture would exercise the existing initial-resolution gate rather than this rebuild path.

The construction is nevertheless unsafe: the Boolean API cannot express unknown, `require_function_contract` has no definedness precondition, and the documentation says the three resolution sites share one callee-prerequisite gate when definedness is actually enforced separately at only two of them.

Make undefined readiness explicit and centralized. Replace the partial Boolean contract answer with a total state such as `Undefined / DefinedWithoutContract / DefinedWithContract`, or enforce the equivalent invariant in a single shared prerequisite gate. A local activation callee whose definition is unavailable must remain unresolved and register the appropriate `FunctionDefined` or `ModuleDefined` readiness dependency; it must never be treated as contract-free. Defined functions without a declaration remain ready without a `FunctionContract` fact. Defined functions with a declaration wait for and then read `FunctionContract`. Preserve provider-boundary semantics: an interface-only external boundary still names no local activation and must not be forced to acquire a local function definition.

Keep `refine_function_call_surface` a pure application step, but make its precondition structurally explicit or asserted so it cannot apply “no contract” to an unknown local function. Route direct calls, protocol-selected targets, and coalesced target rebuilding through the same readiness authority; remove superseded duplicate guards.

Red-first acceptance coverage:
1. Placeholder and Noted local functions do not produce a ready/no-contract answer and register the correct readiness dependency.
2. A Defined function without `@spec` is ready without `FunctionContract`.
3. A Defined function with `@spec` waits for and then reads `FunctionContract`.
4. A provider boundary retains its current contract-only/no-local-activation behavior.
5. Coalesced rebuilding cannot bypass the shared definedness invariant.
6. The existing one-block callee-prerequisite test remains green and no avoidable wait ladder is introduced.
7. Add a late-module integration fixture only if it exercises the new shared gate; do not use it as evidence for the previously unreachable rebuild claim.
title: Encode undefined-function readiness in the shared callee-prerequisite gate
